name: code-reviewer
description: Code review toolkit with a general Code Reviewer agent for independent feature and merge-readiness review, plus specialized agents for duplicate detection, EUII leak scanning, exception handling, test coverage, design and code simplification, over-engineering and scope creep, architecture, performance, schema and wire compatibility, feature-flag rollout, severity grading, logs, and PR context. Includes provider-aware review automation, structured comment publishing, and batch PR review orchestration.
